plain: A cost for drifting too far from the original model, so training can't chase the judge's score too hard.
eli5: A leash: the dog can explore, but not run off after every smell.
technical: A term −β·KL(π ‖ π<sub>ref</sub>) added to the RLHF objective that limits how far the policy moves from its reference model, which bounds how much reward-model error it can exploit.
formula: maximise E[r(x, y)] − β · KL(π ‖ π<sub>ref</sub>)
